senses.gloss:
चङ्कुणः,
 
-रः 
__1 A tree. 
__2 A carriage. 
__3 A vehicle in general (n. also).

a. [क्रम् यङ् ल्युट् यञो लुक् [[Tv.]]] 
__1 Moving about, taking exercise. 
__2 Going slowly or crookedly. 
__3 Moving or going about, walking; विष चङ्क्रमणं रात्रौ [[Chāṇ. 97]]; चक्रे स चक्रेनिभचङ्क्रमणच्छलेन [[N. 1. 144]]; स्वजन्मना चङ्क्रमणेन चाञ्चति [[Bhāg. 1. 10. 26.]] 
__4 Going slowly or tortuously. 
__5 Leap, jump, spring; [[Pt. 4.]]

a. 
__1 Handsome, beautiful. 
__2 Clever. 
__3 Healthy, sound.

__1 Wood-sorrel. 
__2 Whiteness or beauty of the teeth.
f. A medicinal herb used as an antidote against bile and wind; चाङ्गेरी वातपित्तहरा काचिदौषधिः (Mar. चुका ?).
